description: Source file implementing monitor statistics handling for prplMesh, including metrics collection, processing, and reporting functions for access points, stations, and radio interfaces.

classes.name: monitor_stats
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting, processing, and reporting network interface and station metrics within prplMesh.

methods.name: monitor_stats::stop
methods.description: Stops monitoring by resetting database and client pointers.

methods.name: monitor_stats::start
methods.description: Initializes monitoring with database and client, returns success status.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_request
methods.description: Adds a measurement request for a specific station MAC address.

methods.name: monitor_stats::send_hostap_measurements
methods.description: Builds and sends host access point measurement response with radio and station stats.

methods.name: monitor_stats::send_associated_sta_link_metrics
methods.description: Builds and sends link metrics for a specific associated station.

methods.name: monitor_stats::process
methods.description: Processes collected data, manages activity notifications, and handles measurement requests.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_ap_metrics
methods.description: Adds AP metrics TLV to a message.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_ap_extended_metrics
methods.description: Adds extended AP metrics TLV to a message.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_ap_assoc_sta_traffic_stat
methods.description: Adds traffic statistics TLV for an associated station.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_ap_assoc_sta_link_metric
methods.description: Adds link metrics TLV for an associated station.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_ap_assoc_wifi_6_sta_status_report
methods.description: Adds WiFi 6 station status report TLV.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_affiliated_sta_metrics
methods.description: Adds metrics for an affiliated station.

methods.name: monitor_stats::add_affiliated_ap_metrics
methods.description: Adds metrics for an affiliated AP.

methods.name: monitor_stats::calculate_client_load
methods.description: Calculates and updates load metrics for a station and associated radio.

methods.name: monitor_stats::recalculate_byte_units
methods.description: Converts byte counts to specified units (KiB or MiB).
